The AI Wave Is Here — First Offline AI Event, Covered by 36氪AI测评

September 2026 · 36氪AI测评 (36Kr AI Review)

36氪AI测评 recapped the first offline AI event jointly hosted by the Moon Bay OPC Community and the Hengtai Zero-Space OPC Community. Held on September 19, 2026 at the Hengtai Star Apartments U+ youth talent space in Suzhou, the afternoon brought four practitioners who shared real-world AI journeys — honestly, demos and mishaps included.

The room was already full by early afternoon. In a modest space hung with slogans like "You can always trust Suzhou" and a sign reading "AI Era · Super Individuals" (AI时代 超级个体), the "wave" arrived ahead of schedule. This was the first offline event in the linked space shared by the Moon Bay Overseas Talent OPC Community and the Hengtai Zero-Space OPC Community.

First up was Zhang Yulei, senior partner at Singapore's Valtimus and Suzhou's Minnas, who framed the "82 Principle" as the most practical takeaway of the day: in the AI era you don't need to do everything yourself — reallocate energy to what matters and let tools and leverage handle the rest. Next, Wu Runyu (Lil_Hard), Co-CEO of the Montreux (China) Jazz Festival, opened his artist-management platform ShowFlow live — and when the system threw a 500 error on stage, he laughed it off: failures are part of any real demo, and AI is not PPT magic but something that can humbly teach you.

Xu Jinyang, an AI engineer, demoed his 清云智矩 AI foreign-trade client-acquisition platform in one go — matching overseas companies, contacts and emails with an 89% confidence score and verified addresses, feeding leads straight into follow-up pipelines; merchants are already closing deals with it. Finally, You Yujing (Flora), founder of FlyTa and an XJTLU CS graduate, shared the "how" of riding the AI wave: from personally compressing research time by ~91% with AI tools, to the Forward Deployed Engineer role that takes AI into real business workflows.

Beyond the talks, the real point was connection — teams formed, WeChat accounts were added, and questions kept flowing long after the formal session ended. For the Moon Bay OPC Community and the Hengtai Zero-Space OPC Community, it marked the start of a new chapter: more AI events to come.
